regulation_clause.text: Closure requests must be honoured within 7 working days (subject to dues); failure incurs a penalty of Rs 500 per calendar day of delay until closure, provided no outstanding.

gold.gold_rationale: T6CL05 scans a business-day table to count WS-BUSINESS-COUNT, then computes WS-CHARGE-DAYS = WS-BUSINESS-COUNT - 7 (line 29) and multiplies by 500. The penalty accrues per business (working) day of delay, not per calendar day as clause 19 requires.

penalty_per_day.note: Floor: minimum penalty the bank owes per calendar day. Stale side is DOWN (1-2-5 ladder: 500 -> 200) - an un-updated older rule pays the customer less. This leaf is why BL-15 exists; comparator now declared, never inferred.

prediction.rationale: The clause requires a penalty of Rs 500 per calendar day of delay. In 2400-SCAN-CALENDAR, the loop increments WS-BUSINESS-COUNT for BUSINESS-DAY entries, then subtracts 7 from that count and multiplies the result by 500. This bases the penalty on excess business days rather than calendar days, contrary to the clause.
